runner_decision_checklist.headline: What participants need before Finding Hope morning at LSUE.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick guide to the walk time, location, purpose, and community-resource activities planned for the morning.

items.label: Walk site
items.detail: The walk is held at LSUE Campus, 2048 Johnson Hwy, Eunice, LA 70535.

items.label: Morning start
items.detail: Walk-up registration and pre-registered participant sign-in begin at 8:00 AM, followed by the welcome, reflection, bracelet presentation, bubble exercise, and the one-mile walk.

items.label: After the walk
items.detail: The schedule continues at 10:00 AM with vendor booths, community resource tables, educational breakout workshops, survivor-family stories, recognition, and an 11:30 AM closing call to action.

items.label: Where proceeds help
items.detail: Money raised supports Living Healed services including suicide-prevention trainings, grief support groups, and educational groups on mental health topics such as anxiety, depression, parenting, trauma, and coping strategies.

items.label: 2025 community response
items.detail: The 2025 walk drew nearly 400 participants and raised more than $14,000, validating the need for continued community education on suicide prevention.

story.title: A one-mile morning of remembrance, support, and local suicide-prevention resources.
paragraphs: The 2nd Annual Finding Hope Suicide Prevention 1-Mile Walk brings families, friends, and supporters to LSUE Campus on Saturday, November 7, 2026.

The morning is built around connection and healing, with a welcome, reflection, worship music, Finding Hope bracelets, a bubble exercise, the one-mile walk, resource tables, educational workshops, and survivor-family stories.

Proceeds support Living Healed services including prevention trainings, grief support groups, and educational groups on mental-health topics such as anxiety, depression, parenting, trauma, and coping strategies.
